prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Reordering sign-in after adoption (sign_in, reorder) yielded a win (+7.0%), though a second attempt showed no clear effect.
Introducing a new flow on home (home, new_flow) and quality guidance hints for adoption (adoption, hint) were helpful (+8.6% and +5.4%).
Streamlining path selection copy (choose_path, copy) hurt performance (-4.7%).
Layout updates, background notifications, tutorial screens, incentives, copy changes, and general hints showed no clear effect.
Predictions were generally too optimistic, overestimating gains for most tests.
Predictions were too low for the winning home new flow (+1.0% predicted vs +8.6% measured).

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, hint: +5.4% over 1 test(s)
- adoption, incentive: +0.3% over 1 test(s)
- adoption, layout: +2.7% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, copy: -4.7% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, hint: +0.5% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, new_flow: +0.2% over 1 test(s)
- finish, copy: -0.5% over 2 test(s)
- finish, new_screen: -0.4% over 1 test(s)
- finish, notification: +5.4% over 1 test(s)
- home, hint: +4.3% over 1 test(s)
- home, new_flow: +2.6% over 2 test(s)
- home, wait_info: -0.5% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: +3.6% over 2 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 78.2%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 64.2%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 83.9%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 20.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [sign_in, hint] Account Persistence & Pet Restore Hint: Adds an explicit explanatory note on the sign-in screen reassuring users that signing in restores existing pets safely without loss. (why: Support mail highlighted 8 issues regarding missing or reset pets after signing in again, leading to user hesitation during sign-in.)
1: [choose_path, layout] Choose Path Two Column Spotlight: Changes path selection screen to a side-by-side two column layout contrasting instant ready-made pets versus custom photo creation. (why: Choose path drop-off is 23.8% (76.2% conversion) with a very long mean duration of 514s, indicating confusion between available paths.)
2: [sign_in, copy] Instant Sign-In Fallback Guidance Copy: Updates sign-in screen headline and body copy with direct connection troubleshooting instructions. (why: Support received 2 bug reports about sign-in screen failing to appear or stalling.)
3: [home, wait_info] Progressive Desktop Loading Indicator: Displays an active step-by-step progress indicator showing desktop initialization phases on the waiting screen. (why: The waiting phase on home takes median 201s and mean 2336s, leaving users unsure if pet creation is progressing.)
4: [choose_path, hint] Instant Path Decision Helper Hint: Adds a friendly decision hint on the story screen helping users choose the fastest path to spawn their first pet. (why: Users take a mean of 514s on path selection before moving forward, indicating early confusion.)

scores.note: Strong alignment between support complaints (8 mails) and sign-in drop-off; hints have shown moderate success.
Targets high drop-off and long duration, but layout updates historically showed no clear effect and cost is high.
Only 2 bug reports provided as evidence, and past copy changes have yielded neutral to negative results.
Home drop-off is relatively low; previous test of home wait_info showed a -0.5% drop.
Easy config hint addressing long choose_path duration; past test of choose_path hint showed +0.5%.
